values.zh-CN: `LinearMap.BilinMap R M Nₗ` 是**同一源空间**的双线性映射类型，定义为 $M\to_{\mathrm{lin}}M\to_{\mathrm{lin}}N$：它对两个（同型的）输入分别线性。两个**不同**空间 $V,W$ 上的双线性映射没有这个同义名，应直接写成嵌套线性映射 $V\to_{\mathrm{lin}}W\to_{\mathrm{lin}}U$。显式参数为 $R\ M\ N$。
values.en: `LinearMap.BilinMap R M Nₗ` is the type of bilinear maps with a **single source space**, defined as $M\to_{\mathrm{lin}}M\to_{\mathrm{lin}}N$: linear in each of its two (identically typed) arguments. A bilinear map on two **different** spaces $V,W$ has no such synonym and is written as the nested linear map $V\to_{\mathrm{lin}}W\to_{\mathrm{lin}}U$. Explicit parameters are $R\ M\ N$.
